objects.name: Analytic 2189
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a network infrastructure device exhibiting behavioral anomalies (unexpected listening ports, new routing entries) after a vendor firmware update or hardware replacement, where the device firmware hash does not match the authorized inventory. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
